notes.title: New Update! Steam cards are in!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We're happy to announce that Mars just got Steam Cards!
In case you haven't played the game in a while, there's new content! :cozybethesda:

Just a reminder, because we heard some players missed last updates and are now very surprised at the amount of new stuff in the game. 

I hope you're all happy with your purchase! 
Mars has grown into a sizeable puzzle game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728961/0d901aebb13c28b9648b050ef9a91aed2408964d.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728961/1d1e82564b693bd909469a3ed9dd0f4252af74b0.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728961/55a00cfc0bc50e5ae6b67899e07ca2e10b39f195.png[/img]

All our players should've received cards already. You can also get badges, emojis and even profile backgrounds now. ːsteamhappyː ːbubbleSmileː ːelectricityOnː ːstrawberryPixelː


Thank you all for playing,
Arek, Lucas, Kuba, Piotr

notes.title: Final Update is here! House building, 24 new levels & more content.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We've just released a new update.
It introduces a new house building mechanic and a set of challenge levels. To get there you will have to gather strawberries (as usual).

This brings the total number of levels to 133. I'm sure this is at least 4 hours of puzzles. This new content breaks the monotony of the first 30 levels, where the game hasn't shown you it's most interesting mechanics yet.

If you'd like to try the house building, separately and for free,[b] check out our little demo.[/b]
18 entirely new levels, based around only house building. For people who don't know if Mars is for them.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1300560/Mars_Power_Industries_First_Job/


Please let us know what you think about this new content and how you feel about the game. We've been thinking about a possible sequel. We've gathered enough experience here.
[b]You can write a review visible for everyone or post in the discussion thread, [/b]

Thank you for reading and thank you everyone who bought the game!

Arek & Lukasz & Piotr & Kuba

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728961/d0d653060e7dff802d558499b3bdbb8e9edfa6e5.png[/img]

notes.title: Deluxe Edition - What's new?
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I think you're all wondering what this Deluxe thing is really about.
Here's a short summary!

[b]First version:[/b]
October 2018 we released Mars Power Industries as a mobile game.
Featured on iTunes by Apple. The result of our 10 months' work from Global Game Jam 2018 when the game was first conceived.

We've worked after hours to complete a playable puzzle game. At first it was only an hour long. 40 simple puzzles. People liked it! We made some updates, we still had more ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728961/55b0ad03de64c3273d32dcb62d027a2b801b5b44.png[/img]

[b]Deluxe Edition:[/b]
We added new mechanics, new buildings and new levels. More music too, I'm an audiophile, we had to expand that area. We've replaced less interesting levels, added new obstacles such as sand worms, visible here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35728961/6d6be08bbc3dffb24824759635df4843b329fdc3.png[/img]

This brings us to a total of 97 levels. The deluxe edition has around 40 new/remastered levels. Twice the music. 
Most importantly - MAC and LINUX support!
[b]Plus a DEMO version! You can try the game for yourself for FREE![/b]

[b]Who we are:[/b]
This game was made by 4 people. We're a group of friends from Lublin, a small town in Poland. That's in Europe!

- Arek, design, art direction and sound
- Kuba, pixel art
- Łukasz, programming, additional design
- Piotr, programming & tools  

We've been making games for some years now. Mars Power Industries started as a learning experience to learn Unity for a game jam, if you can believe that. We've been trying to make Mars Power Industries a fun, tight puzzle game for 2 years now. 2 years of hard work after hours. It's been a very wild ride.
We hope we succeeded!
